slots.video_prompt:
Create one continuous 6-second 9:16 photorealistic Taiwanese laundry inspection-counter shot about 衣物. Fixed close camera with layered depth: one complete garment in the foreground with one existing collar or hem folded inward, a clean inspection tray in the midground, and one softly glowing practical lamp in the background. One adult hand performs one dominant action only: lift only that existing collar or hem to reveal the inside surface, then stop. Preserve exactly one garment, its sleeves, collar, seams and natural folds, five fingers, realistic weight and contact shadows. No cleaning transformation, no extra hands, no duplicate object, no morphing, no penetration, no readable text, no logo, no watermark. End on the revealed detail and hold for one second.

Item profile 2026-08-05-v1: 衣物類：把領口、袖口、腋下或洗標做成唯一可見重點；只做一次翻面或平放動作，保留布料皺褶與原始狀態，不呈現洗後效果。

video_candidate.conflict: 衣物的領口或布邊仍折在內側，接觸皮膚的位置第一眼看不完整。
video_candidate.single_action: 同一隻成人手只掀開衣物的一個既有領口或布邊，露出內側後停住。
video_candidate.payoff: 先看材質、位置與原始狀態，再決定怎麼處理。
video_candidate.cta: 拍全貌、局部與洗標，點個人檔案連結加 LINE 先詢問。
video_candidate.first_frame_direction: 固定直式微距中近景；完整衣物位於乾淨檢查台前景，檢查燈與收納托盤形成中後景層次；只有一隻手停在既有可動位置，物件數量、材質、縫線與接觸陰影清楚，無文字。
